text:
{
  "pros": [
    "Extremely comprehensive feature set, aiming to be an 'all-in-one' solution.",
    "High degree of customization and flexibility to adapt to various workflows.",
    "Multiple views (List, Board, Calendar, Gantt, etc.) for diverse preferences.",
    "Strong collaboration features for team communication and project tracking.",
    "Good value for money, especially given the extensive functionality.",
    "Frequent updates and new features are regularly introduced."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Steep learning curve due to the sheer number of features and options.",
    "Can feel overwhelming and complex, leading to initial setup challenges.",
    "Performance issues, including slow loading times or occasional lag.",
    "Frequent bugs or glitches, especially after major updates.",
    "Mobile app functionality is often less robust and can be clunky.",
    "The user interface can be cluttered or intrusive, especially with default panels."
  ],
  "changed": [
    "cons: Replaced 'Notification system can be overwhelming or difficult to manage effectively.' with 'The user interface can be cluttered or intrusive, especially with default panels.' based on the note '[friction] A Brain AI chat panel opened by default and took about a third of the screen, which squeezed the list so task names and the custom field column were truncated.' and '[friction] The dropdown field form starts with placeholder options 'Option 1' and 'Option 2' that have to be overwritten one at a time, and the Fields panel covers most of the task list while open.'"
  ]
}

pros: Extremely comprehensive feature set, aiming to be an 'all-in-one' solution.
High degree of customization and flexibility to adapt to various workflows.
Multiple views (List, Board, Calendar, Gantt, etc.) for diverse preferences.
Strong collaboration features for team communication and project tracking.
Good value for money, especially given the extensive functionality.
Frequent updates and new features are regularly introduced.
cons: Steep learning curve due to the sheer number of features and options.
Can feel overwhelming and complex, leading to initial setup challenges.
Performance issues, including slow loading times or occasional lag.
Frequent bugs or glitches, especially after major updates.
Mobile app functionality is often less robust and can be clunky.
The user interface can be cluttered or intrusive, especially with default panels.
changed: cons: Replaced 'Notification system can be overwhelming or difficult to manage effectively.' with 'The user interface can be cluttered or intrusive, especially with default panels.' based on the note '[friction] A Brain AI chat panel opened by default and took about a third of the screen, which squeezed the list so task names and the custom field column were truncated.' and '[friction] The dropdown field form starts with placeholder options 'Option 1' and 'Option 2' that have to be overwritten one at a time, and the Fields panel covers most of the task list while open.'
